specialists.name: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
specialists.qualifications: MD (General Physician SVIMS), Ex. Senior Resident (SVIMS), Ex. Resident (JIPMER), Fellowship in Clinical Endocrinology & Diabetes RCP (London), Fellowship in Diabetes and Renal Management RCP (London)
specialists.bio: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy is the Founder and Chief Physician & Diabetologist at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam. With prestigious clinical qualifications from SVIMS (MD & Ex. Senior Resident), JIPMER, and the Royal College of Physicians (London), he has spearheaded advanced evidence-based diabetology, chronic disease management, and Khammam's premier 24/7 Daycare Transfusion Centre for Thalassemia and Sickle Cell Anemia.
specialists.content:
Founder & Chief Physician Profile

Dr. D. Narayana Murthy, M.D. (Registration No. 81187) brings over 22 years of elite clinical expertise to Khammam and neighboring districts. His academic and clinical foundation stems from premier national and international centers of excellence:

  • MD (General Physician) – Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences (SVIMS, Tirupati)
  • Ex. Senior Resident – SVIMS (Tirupati)
  • Ex. Resident – Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (JIPMER, Puducherry)
  • Fellowship in Clinical Endocrinology & Diabetes – Royal College of Physicians (RCP, London)
  • Fellowship in Diabetes and Renal Management – Royal College of Physicians (RCP, London)

Institutional Mission & Practice Philosophy

At Rithanya Hospital, Dr. Narayana Murthy emphasizes holistic, guideline-directed medical therapy. His practice focuses on early organ protection in patients with diabetes, hypertension, and metabolic syndrome. Recognizing the immense challenges faced by families of children with Thalassemia and Sickle Cell Anemia, he established Rithanya Hospital's dedicated Daycare Transfusion Centre and 24/7 Blood Bank with full Aarogyasri cashless coverage.

Areas of Clinical Focus

  • Complex Diabetes Management & Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM)
  • Diabetic Nephropathy, Retinopathy, and Diabetic Foot Neuropathy Salvage
  • Daycare Blood Transfusion Protocols for Thalassemia Major
  • Cardio-Renal Risk Profiling and Refractory Hypertension Care
  • 24/7 Acute Medical Emergencies & Triage

specialists.name: Dr. A. Lakshmi Deepa (డా॥ ఎ. లక్ష్మీదీప)
specialists.designation: Co-Founder & Consultant Gynecologist / Women's Health Specialist (స్త్రీల వైద్య నిపుణులు)
specialists.bio: Dr. A. Lakshmi Deepa is the Co-Founder and Senior Consultant Gynecologist & Women's Health Specialist at Rithanya Hospital. Dedicated to compassionate, confidential, and comprehensive healthcare for women at every stage of life, from adolescent health and PCOS management to antenatal care and perimenopausal support.
specialists.content:
Co-Founder & Women's Health Specialist Profile

Dr. A. Lakshmi Deepa, M.B.B.S. (Registration No. 19422) serves as Co-Founder and Lead Consultant for Women's Health at Rithanya Hospital, Khammam. With over 16 years of devoted clinical service, her practice is centered on empathetic, ethical, and evidence-guided care tailored to women's unique physiological needs.

Core Clinical Specialties

  • Antenatal & Maternal Health: Comprehensive prenatal screenings, gestational diabetes surveillance in coordination with diabetology, and maternal nutritional optimization.
  • Menstrual & Endocrine Disorders: Holistic management of Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS/PCOD), irregular cycles, dysmenorrhea, and hormonal imbalances.
  • Adolescent Reproductive Guidance: Nutritional anemia prevention, pubertal transitions, and health literacy counseling for adolescent girls.
  • Perimenopausal & Menopausal Health: Bone density preservation, hormonal transition support, and holistic wellness for mature women.
  • Preventive Cervical & Breast Screenings: Early detection protocols, Pap smears, and routine preventive wellness checkups.

treatments.title: Malaria (మలేరియా)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Periodic chills and rigors followed by high spiking fever and profuse sweating, headache, anemia, jaundice.
treatments.summary: Rapid antigen testing, peripheral blood smear Giemsa stain, Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT), and relapse eradication.
treatments.content:
Evidence-Based Malaria Diagnosis and Cure

Malaria caused by Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum requires exact species identification to eradicate dormant liver hypnozoites and avert cerebral complications.

Diagnostic & Treatment Steps

  • Peripheral Blood Smear: High-resolution Giemsa microscopy for ring forms and schizonts.
  • Artemisinin Combination Therapy: Oral Artemether-Lumefantrine or IV Artesunate for severe infections.
  • Relapse Prevention: Primaquine course under G6PD enzyme safety verification.
procedures: G6PD screening and Primaquine anti-relapse protocol

treatments.title: Dengue (డెంగ్యూ)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Acute high fever, retro-orbital eye pain, severe joint pain, thrombocytopenia (falling platelets), bleeding spots.
treatments.summary: Strict hematocrit hemoconcentration tracking, precision IV fluid titration, and 24/7 in-house Rithanya Blood Bank platelet standby.
treatments.content:
Structured Clinical Dengue Management

Dengue fever can progress rapidly to Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) due to vascular plasma leakage. Rithanya Hospital combines continuous hematocrit tracking with in-house 24/7 blood bank support to manage thrombocytopenia safely.

Clinical Protocols

  • Rapid Serology: Stat NS1 antigen on day 1-5, followed by IgM and IgG antibody confirmation.
  • Hematocrit & Platelet Surveillance: Serial automated CBC testing every 8 to 12 hours to preempt capillary leak.
  • Precision Fluid Resuscitation: Calibrated crystalloid infusions to maintain intravascular volume without causing pulmonary edema.
  • In-House Blood Bank: Immediate availability of crossmatched platelets and packed red cells.
procedures: Rapid Dengue NS1 Antigen & IgM/IgG automated test
Serial platelet counts and hematocrit (PCV) tracking

treatments.title: Dizziness / Vertigo (తల తిరుగుట)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Spinning sensation of surroundings, loss of balance upon turning head, lightheadedness, nausea, unsteadiness.
treatments.summary: Dix-Hallpike diagnostic test, Epley canalith repositioning, vestibular suppressant titration, and orthostatic BP screening.
treatments.content:
Diagnosis and Physical Treatment of Vertigo

Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV), labyrinthitis, and cervical vestibular disorders can be cured effectively using specific bedside canalith repositioning maneuvers rather than prolonged sedation.

Clinical Protocols

  • Dix-Hallpike Test: Provocative positioning to identify displaced otolith crystals in the posterior semicircular canal.
  • Epley Maneuver: Gentle head-turning maneuver to guide otoliths back into the vestibule.
  • Orthostatic Pressure Check: Ruling out postural hypotension as a cause for lightheadedness.
procedures: Lying vs standing orthostatic blood pressure check

treatments.title: Muscle Cramps/Pains in Sleep (నిద్రలో కండరాల నొప్పులు)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Sudden nocturnal calf spasms, involuntary toe clenching during sleep, daytime residual muscle soreness.
treatments.summary: Electrolyte optimization, correction of occult magnesium and Vitamin D3 deficiency, and peripheral circulatory support.
treatments.content:
Relief from Nocturnal Muscle Cramps

Sudden, painful muscle spasms during sleep frequently disrupt sleep architecture and signal underlying electrolyte depletion, venous insufficiency, or diabetic peripheral nerve irritation.

Care Protocol

  • Biochemical Screening: Evaluating serum magnesium, calcium, potassium, and vitamin D3 reserves.
  • Vascular Pulse Palpation: Assessing dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses for arterial sufficiency.
  • Neuromuscular Restorative Regimen: Prescribing targeted bioavailable magnesium, calf stretching regimens, and adequate bedtime hydration.
procedures: Vitamin D3 and B-complex restorative therapy

treatments.title: Asthma (అస్తమా (ఉబ్బసం))
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Recurrent wheezing, nighttime coughing, chest tightness, dyspnea triggered by dust, cold air, or seasonal pollen.
treatments.summary: Airway hyperresponsiveness evaluation, metered-dose inhaler spacer coaching, and step-up/step-down long-term controller therapy.
treatments.content:
Modern Bronchial Asthma Care

Asthma is a chronic inflammatory disorder of the bronchial tree. At Rithanya Hospital, our clinical protocol focuses on identifying individual allergic triggers and controlling inflammation at the mucosal level rather than relying solely on rescue bronchodilators.

Treatment Pathway

  • Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR): Quantitative monitoring of diurnal bronchial constriction.
  • Inhaler Technique Calibration: Hands-on training with spacer devices to guarantee lung deposition and minimize oral candidiasis.
  • Step-Up & Step-Down Regimens: Tailored combination of inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) and long-acting beta-agonists (LABA).
  • Acute Exacerbation Protocol: Bedside oxygenation and pressurized nebulization for severe attacks.
procedures: Peak expiratory flow rate (PEFR) bedside assessment

treatments.title: BP / Hypertension (బి.పి.)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Systolic blood pressure ≥ 140 mmHg or diastolic ≥ 90 mmHg, morning occipital headaches, palpitations, dizziness, or target organ screening.
treatments.summary: Evidence-based blood pressure profiling, ambulatory continuous monitoring, end-organ vascular protection, and customized dietary sodium management.
treatments.content:
Evidence-Based Hypertension Management

Hypertension is a silent vascular disease that places continuous strain on the heart, cerebral arteries, and renal glomeruli. Under the direction of Dr. D. Narayana Murthy, Rithanya Hospital provides comprehensive hypertension workups to identify primary versus secondary causes and protect long-term vitality.

Structured Clinical Care Protocol

  • 24-Hour Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring: Distinguishing white-coat hypertension from nocturnal non-dipping patterns.
  • Cardio-Renal Risk Stratification: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) and 12-lead digital ECG to detect early left ventricular hypertrophy.
  • Lipid & Metabolic Profiling: Assessing concurrent cardiovascular risks including dyslipidemia and insulin resistance.
  • Lifestyle & Dietary Counseling: Tailored low-sodium, potassium-rich regional dietary plans combined with optimized antihypertensive therapy.
procedures: Automated digital multi-reading blood pressure assessment
Urine microalbuminuria and renal function assessment

treatments.title: Nerve Weakness (నరముల బలహీనత)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Symmetrical tingling, "pins and needles", burning sensation in soles, loss of temperature perception, motor weakness.
treatments.summary: Quantitative biothesiometry, 10-point monofilament testing, neurotrophic pharmacological support, and diabetic foot protection.
treatments.content:
Diabetic and Peripheral Neuropathy Care

Peripheral neuropathy is a major microvascular complication of long-standing diabetes that can lead to unnoticed skin trauma and non-healing ulcers if left untreated.

Care Pathway

  • Vibration Perception Threshold (VPT): Quantitative testing of large-fiber sensory loss.
  • Monofilament Sensory Mapping: Identifying high-risk pressure zones on the soles.
  • Neurotrophic Therapy: Alpha-lipoic acid, methylcobalamin, and strict glycemic stabilization.

treatments.title: Headache (తలనొప్పి)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Chronic tension headache, band-like constriction around head, stress-related cephalalgia, eye-strain, neck stiffness.
treatments.summary: Cranial nerve neurological evaluation, exclusion of secondary hypertension or intracranial causes, and ergonomic therapy.
treatments.content:
Diagnostic Evaluation for Chronic Headaches

Headaches range from benign tension-type episodes to manifestations of severe secondary hypertension or neurological disease. Careful clinical examination reveals the underlying cause.

Clinical Protocols

  • Neurological Screening: Fundoscopic examination to rule out papilledema and cranial nerve assessment.
  • Vascular & Blood Pressure Review: Measuring resting blood pressure and cervical spine alignment.
  • Preventive Management: Safe non-opioid analgesics, stress reduction techniques, and screen-time posture adjustments.
procedures: Cranial nerve and ophthalmic fundoscopy examination
Blood pressure and cervical muscle spasm assessment

treatments.title: Constipation (మలబద్ధకం)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Infrequent bowel movements (<3/week), hard pellet-like stools, straining, feeling of incomplete evacuation, hemorrhoid risk.
treatments.summary: Dietary soluble/insoluble fiber optimization, metabolic motility evaluation (thyroid, diabetes), and safe non-habit-forming laxatives.
treatments.content:
Restoring Natural Bowel Motility

Chronic constipation often reflects inadequate hydration, insufficient fiber intake, or underlying metabolic slowed motility (such as hypothyroidism or diabetic enteropathy).

Care Pathway

  • Metabolic Screening: Evaluating thyroid function, calcium levels, and diabetic glycemic regulation.
  • Hydration & Fiber Protocol: Tailoring dietary ispaghula husk and regional fiber sources.
  • Osmotic Laxatives: Polyethylene glycol or lactulose regimens that soften stools without creating colon dependence.
procedures: Abdominal palpation and rectal examination if indicated

treatments.title: Erectile Dysfunction (అంగస్తంభన లేకపోవడం)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual performance, diabetic vascular insufficiency.
treatments.summary: Discreet confidential consultation addressing endothelial function, testosterone levels, glycemic control, and safe PDE-5 inhibitors.
treatments.content:
Confidential Medical Care for Erectile Dysfunction

Erectile dysfunction is an early barometer of cardiovascular health and endothelial dysfunction, especially in men with diabetes or hypertension. Dr. Narayana Murthy provides respectful, scientifically validated care.

Clinical Protocols

  • Vascular & Endocrine Assessment: Measuring Total Testosterone, Fasting Glucose, Lipid panel, and evaluating peripheral pulses.
  • Cardiovascular Safety Clearance: Ensuring compatibility with any existing cardiac medications before prescribing.
  • Modern PDE-5 Inhibitor Titration: Individualized medical therapy for reliable, safe erectile recovery.
procedures: Serum Total Testosterone and lipid/glucose audit

treatments.title: Forgetfulness, Anxiety (మతిమరుపు, ఆందోళన)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Short-term memory lapses, racing thoughts, panic sensations, restlessness, cognitive fatigue in elderly or stressed professionals.
treatments.summary: Cognitive mental status examination (MMSE), ruling out pseudodementia from B12 deficiency, and neuro-calming therapies.
treatments.content:
Cognitive Function and Anxiety Relief

Mild forgetfulness and generalized anxiety are frequently intertwined, driven by chronic stress, sleep deficits, or metabolic deficiencies that mimic early dementia.

Diagnostic Workup

  • Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE): Objective scoring of orientation, registration, recall, and attention.
  • Reversible Cause Screening: Testing serum Vitamin B12, Folate, and Thyroid hormones.
  • Neuro-Calming Support: Tailored anxiolytic regimens, breathing exercises, and cognitive memory stimulation.
procedures: Serum Vitamin B12, Folate, and TSH testing

treatments.title: COVID-19 (కోవిడ్-19)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Fever, persistent cough, loss of smell or taste, shortness of breath, body aches, post-COVID syndrome.
treatments.summary: Rapid antigen testing, SpO2 monitoring, inflammatory marker evaluation, and evidence-based post-viral recovery rehabilitation.
treatments.content:
COVID-19 Care and Post-Viral Recovery

From acute symptomatic COVID-19 to long-COVID fatigue, our clinical care focuses on preventing hypoxia and supporting respiratory and metabolic recovery.

Care Pathway

  • Oxygenation Tracking: Continuous pulse oximetry monitoring to catch silent hypoxia.
  • Inflammatory Surveillance: Evaluating CRP, Ferritin, and D-Dimer in moderate-to-severe cases.
  • Post-COVID Rehabilitation: Deep breathing exercises and nutritional conditioning for lingering weakness.
procedures: Serial SpO2 and respiratory rate tracking

treatments.title: Numbness, Allergy (తిమ్మిర్లు, ఎలర్జీ)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Urticarial wheals, cutaneous itching, angioedema, localized numbness, contact dermatitis, food/drug allergies.
treatments.summary: Allergen identification, non-sedating antihistamine therapy, systemic stabilization, and cutaneous sensory nerve mapping.
treatments.content:
Allergy Care and Neuromuscular Sensitivity

Systemic allergic responses range from mild urticaria to life-threatening anaphylaxis. Our team provides fast relief and structured allergen trigger prevention.

Care Steps

  • Immune & Eosinophil Profiling: Total serum IgE and absolute eosinophil count (AEC) assessment.
  • Allergen Elimination Counseling: Reviewing seasonal, dietary, and medication triggers.
  • Sensory Mapping: Differentiating allergic cutaneous irritation from neurological peripheral parasthesias.
procedures: Absolute eosinophil count (AEC) and total IgE testing

treatments.title: Mental / Psychological Issues (మానసిక సమస్యలు)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Depressive episodes, persistent low mood, loss of interest, somatic bodily pains without organic cause, emotional distress.
treatments.summary: Confidential empathetic clinical consultation, ruling out organic endocrine imbalances (Thyroid, B12), and supportive therapy.
treatments.content:
Empathetic Care for Mental & Emotional Well-Being

Mental health concerns frequently manifest as unexplained somatic aches, digestive issues, and extreme exhaustion. Rithanya Hospital provides confidential, dignified physician consultations.

Care Pathway

  • Organic Disease Screening: Checking Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3, and thyroid levels that directly affect neurotransmitters.
  • Clinical Scoring: Utilizing standard PHQ-9 depression screening tools.
  • Supportive Medical Therapy: Non-habit-forming modern anxiolytics/antidepressants combined with lifestyle and stress counseling.

treatments.title: Poisoning (పాయిజనింగ్)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Accidental or intentional ingestion of organophosphates, pesticides, rodenticides, household chemicals, or toxic drugs.
treatments.summary: Rapid gastric decontamination, targeted antidote administration (Atropine, PAM), ICU hemodynamic resuscitation, and biochemical monitoring.
treatments.content:
24/7 Acute Poisoning and Toxicology Resuscitation

Acute pesticide and toxic ingestion require immediate airway management, decontamination, and prompt antidote titration to prevent respiratory arrest and multiorgan failure.

Resuscitation Protocol

  • Airway & Gastric Decontamination: Secure airway placement and gastric lavage with activated charcoal when indicated.
  • Specific Antidote Therapy: Full atropinization and Pralidoxime (PAM) infusion for organophosphate pesticide poisoning.
  • Metabolic & Organ Protection: Serial arterial blood gases (ABG), liver function, and renal function profiling.
procedures: Emergency gastric lavage under airway protection
Arterial blood gas (ABG) and electrolyte monitoring

treatments.title: Typhoid (టైఫాయిడ్)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Step-ladder persistent fever, severe frontal headache, abdominal tenderness, coated tongue, relative bradycardia.
treatments.summary: TyphiDot IgM antibody testing, sensitive antibiotic regimens overcoming multi-drug resistance, and enteric dietary nutrition.
treatments.content:
Targeted Therapy for Enteric / Typhoid Fever

Typhoid fever caused by Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi is a serious systemic infection. Prompt sensitive antibiotic therapy prevents intestinal hemorrhage or perforation.

Care Protocol

  • Serological & Blood Screening: Rapid TyphiDot IgM testing combined with complete hemogram showing leukopenia.
  • Targeted Antimicrobial Regimen: Third-generation cephalosporins (Ceftriaxone) or Azithromycin based on regional sensitivity profiles.
  • Enteric Diet Guidance: High-calorie, easily digestible bland foods to safeguard gut mucosal healing.
procedures: TyphiDot rapid IgM/IgG test and Widal assessment

treatments.title: Breathlessness / Fatigue (ఆయాసం)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Exertional dyspnea, persistent chronic exhaustion, rapid fatigue during routine activities, post-viral convalescence.
treatments.summary: Multisystem workup identifying occult anemia, cardiopulmonary insufficiency, electrolyte imbalances, and metabolic decompensation.
treatments.content:
Investigating Chronic Breathlessness and Fatigue

Unexplained fatigue and exertional breathlessness often result from multiple interrelated physiological factors, including severe anemia, occult thyroid dysfunction, subclinical heart failure, or uncontrolled diabetes.

Diagnostic Workup

  • Cardiopulmonary Vitals: Exertional oxygen desaturation profiling and 12-lead ECG.
  • Hematological Screening: Complete blood count, ferritin, and peripheral blood morphology.
  • Metabolic Audit: Renal markers, serum electrolytes, liver enzymes, and thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH).

treatments.title: Cough, Cold (దగ్గు, జలుబు)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Acute upper respiratory tract infections, viral rhinitis, pharyngitis, allergic hacking cough, seasonal flu.
treatments.summary: Targeted symptomatic relief, rational antibiotic stewardship, soothing saline nebulization, and secondary infection prevention.
treatments.content:
Upper Respiratory Care & Antibiotic Stewardship

The vast majority of cough and cold episodes are caused by viral pathogens where irrational antibiotic usage causes gut dysbiosis without therapeutic benefit. At Rithanya Hospital, we emphasize evidence-based symptomatic therapy.

Clinical Guidance

  • ENT & Chest Auscultation: Confirming clear breath sounds and excluding secondary bacterial bronchitis.
  • Targeted Symptomatic Relief: Non-sedating antihistamines, saline steam inhalation, and cough suppressants tailored to productive vs dry cough.
  • Immunity & Hydration: Electrolyte fluid maintenance and fever tracking.
procedures: Chest auscultation for wheezes or rales

treatments.title: Migraine Headache (మైగ్రెయిన్ తలనొప్పి)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Unilateral throbbing or pulsating headache, visual aura (flashing lights), severe nausea, photophobia, phonophobia.
treatments.summary: Abortive migraine therapy (triptans), evidence-based daily prophylaxis, trigger identification diary, and dark-room rest protocols.
treatments.content:
Targeted Neuro-Vascular Migraine Management

Migraine is a neuro-vascular condition caused by trigemino-vascular activation. Effective therapy combines acute abortive treatment with daily prophylaxis to reduce attack frequency.

Treatment Protocol

  • Trigger Identification: Dietary, hormonal, sleep, and weather-related trigger mapping.
  • Acute Abortive Therapy: Specific triptans and antiemetics taken at the earliest onset of headache or aura.
  • Prophylactic Therapy: Beta-blockers, calcium channel blockers, or anticonvulsants for frequent disabling attacks.

treatments.title: Kidney Stones, Kidney Diseases (కిడ్నీలో రాళ్లు, కిడ్నీ వ్యాధులు)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Colicky flank pain radiating to groin, hematuria, renal calculi, diabetic nephropathy, elevated creatinine, proteinuria.
treatments.summary: High-resolution renal ultrasound, eGFR kidney function monitoring, stone medical expulsive therapy, and nephroprotective care.
treatments.content:
Kidney Stone Management and Renal Health Preservation

With Dr. Narayana Murthy's fellowship in Diabetes and Renal Management (RCP, London), Rithanya Hospital offers specialized care for both acute renal calculi and chronic diabetic kidney disease.

Clinical Protocols

  • Renal Ultrasonography: Identifying stone size, location, and presence of hydronephrosis.
  • Medical Expulsive Therapy (MET): Alpha-blockers and hydration to assist spontaneous stone passage for calculi < 7mm.
  • Diabetic Kidney Protection: Microalbuminuria tracking and SGLT2 inhibitor therapy to arrest glomerulosclerosis.
procedures: Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea, and eGFR profiling
Urine microscopy for crystals and microalbuminuria
Medical expulsive therapy and dietary oxalates counseling

treatments.title: Neck Pains (మెడనొప్పులు)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Cervical muscle spasm, pain radiating down the arm (cervical radiculopathy), computer/smartphone neck strain, occipital stiffness.
treatments.summary: Cervical spine curvature radiography, ergonomic postural corrections, targeted muscle relaxants, and cervical isometric exercises.
treatments.content:
Relief from Cervical Spondylosis and Neck Strain

Prolonged forward-head posture and cervical disc wear compress cervical nerve roots and cause persistent muscle spasm. Conservative medical therapy relieves pain and restores neck range of motion.

Care Pathway

  • Cervical Radiography: Assessing cervical lordosis, disc height, and neural foramen osteophytes.
  • Neurological Radicular Screening: Checking arm reflexes, sensory dermatomes, and grip strength.
  • Targeted Medical & Physical Therapy: Muscle relaxants, local anti-inflammatory agents, and cervical isometric exercises.

treatments.title: Thyroid (థైరాయిడ్)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Unexplained weight changes, fatigue, cold/heat intolerance, hair thinning, neck swelling (goiter), irregular periods, mood changes.
treatments.summary: Chemiluminescent Free T3, Free T4, TSH quantitation, personalized Levothyroxine hormone titration, and metabolic balance.
treatments.content:
Endocrine Care for Thyroid Disorders

Hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism deeply impact cardiovascular function, lipid metabolism, and energy levels. Precise biochemical quantification guides optimal replacement therapy.

Care Pathway

  • Chemiluminescent Hormone Profiling: Measuring high-sensitivity TSH alongside Free T3 and Free T4.
  • Thyroid Ultrasonography: Detecting multi-nodular goiter or Hashimoto's thyroiditis features.
  • Weight-Adjusted Hormone Titration: Individualized morning Levothyroxine dosing with periodic monitoring.
procedures: Chemiluminescent high-sensitivity T3, T4, TSH panel
Thyroid clinical palpation and ultrasound review

treatments.title: Sugar / Diabetes (షుగర్)
treatments.doctorName: Dr. D. Narayana Murthy (డా॥ డి. నారాయణమూర్తి)
treatments.indications: Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, pre-diabetes, gestational diabetes, polyuria, unhealed skin lesions, or erratic glycemic variability.
treatments.summary: Gold-standard HPLC glycated hemoglobin assessment, personalized insulin & oral medication titration, and early cardio-renal microvascular protection.
treatments.content:
Specialized Diabetology by Dr. D. Narayana Murthy

With international fellowship training in clinical endocrinology, diabetes, and renal management from the Royal College of Physicians (London), Dr. D. Treatment Protocol

Care Protocol

services.title: Comprehensive Diabetes & Metabolic Care
services.author: Dr. Narayana Murthy, MD (Diabetologist)
services.summary: Comprehensive blood glucose monitoring, HbA1c reviews, diabetic foot care, and customized lifestyle and medication management.
services.content:
Modern Diabetes Management in Khammam

Diabetes is not merely an elevated blood sugar number; it is a vascular condition that requires holistic protection of the heart, kidneys, retinas, and peripheral nerves. Dr. Narayana Murthy brings specialized diabetology focus to ensure patients manage life with vitality and confidence.

Structured Care Protocols

  • Quarterly HbA1c Monitoring: Laboratory assessment coupled with home blood glucose meter reconciliation.
  • Diabetic Neuropathy & Foot Screen: Monofilament sensation testing, peripheral pulse examination, and footwear education to avert diabetic foot complications.
  • Cardio-Renal Risk Profiling: Urine microalbumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) and lipid panel testing to protect kidney filtration.
  • Diet & Nutrition Counseling: Practical regional dietary guidelines adapted to South Indian culinary preferences.
Patient First Philosophy: We empower patients with direct knowledge of hypoglycemia warning signs, safe carbohydrate distribution, and insulin injection techniques.

services.title: Senior Citizen & Preventive Health Checks
services.author: Preventive Care Team
services.summary: Structured annual and bi-annual wellness evaluations targeting cardiovascular health, diabetes screening, and geriatric mobility.
services.content:
Proactive Wellness vs. Reactive Treatment

Preventive health checks detect metabolic risk factors—such as border-line hypertension, silent dyslipidemia, and pre-diabetes—years before clinical symptoms manifest.

services.title: Thalassemia & Sickle-Cell Transfusion Day-care
services.author: Clinical Day-Care Team
services.summary: Specialized day-care transfusion beds with certified blood filtration, pre-transfusion cross-matching, and routine iron chelation follow-up.
services.content:
Dedicated Day-Care Transfusion Support

Rithanya Hospital is widely recognized across Khammam for its dedicated day-care support for young individuals and adults living with Beta Thalassemia Major and Sickle-Cell Disease. Transfusions should never feel like an intimidating hospital admission—they are conducted in a peaceful, supportive day-care setting.

Safety & Protocol Checklist

  • Pre-Transfusion Blood Cross-Matching: Rigorous ABO and Rh(D) verification, saline cross-matching, and complete blood count (CBC) prior to every unit.
  • Leukodepletion Micro-filtration: Transfusions utilize modern micro-aggregate blood filters to prevent febrile non-hemolytic transfusion reactions (FNHTR).
  • Regular Iron Chelation Auditing: Monitoring of serum ferritin levels and coordinating oral chelation dosages to protect cardiac and hepatic tissues.
  • Compassionate Pediatric Support: Dedicated nursing team trained in sensitive venous access for young warriors.
Emergency Blood Bank Coordination: Our in-house refrigerated blood reserve collaborates closely with the Khammam Red Cross and District Blood Center for timely blood availability.

services.title: Diagnostics & Laboratory Services
services.author: Diagnostic Laboratory Team
services.summary: Automated haematology, complete lipid panels, liver & renal profiles, glucose monitoring, and rapid febrile antigen screening.
services.content:
Diagnostic Precision at Rithanya

Accurate clinical treatment depends on dependable laboratory diagnostics. Our facility features calibrated analyzers operating with strict internal controls to deliver timely reports for outpatients, emergency walk-ins, and day-care visitors.

Key Diagnostic Panels Available

  • Complete Blood Count (CBC) & ESR: 3-part automated differential profiling of haemoglobin, haematocrit, platelets, and white blood cells.
  • Metabolic & Organ Panels: Fasting & postprandial glucose, Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), and Liver Function Tests (LFT).
  • Lipid & Cardiovascular Markers: Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL, LDL, and VLDL ratios.
  • Infectious Serology: Rapid Dengue NS1 & IgM/IgG, Malarial Antigen (Pv/Pf), Typhoid Widal/TyphiDot, and viral hepatitis screens.

services.title: Pediatric Consultation & Child Health
services.author: Visiting Pediatric Specialists
services.summary: Dedicated physician reviews for childhood infections, seasonal fevers, nutritional guidance, and preventive pediatric health checks.
services.content:
Attentive Pediatric Care

Children require specialized physiological attention, weight-tailored medication dosing, and a gentle clinic atmosphere that eases medical anxiety.

services.title: General Medicine & Physician Consultation
services.author: Dr. Narayana Murthy, MD
services.summary: Evidence-based diagnosis and ongoing physician care for fevers, infections, metabolic disorders, and chronic conditions.
services.content:
Overview of Physician Care

At Rithanya Hospital, General Medicine forms the foundational bedrock of all outpatient and inpatient care. Under the clinical leadership of Dr. Narayana Murthy (MBBS, MD), patients receive attentive, unrushed evaluations where every symptom is contextualized within their long-term health history.

Our Core Clinical Approach: We avoid unnecessary polypharmacy and fragmented testing. We prioritize accurate clinical examination, baseline blood profiling, and structured follow-up so treatment plans adapt to patient progress.

Conditions Treated

  • Acute Febrile Illnesses: Precise differential diagnosis for viral fevers, seasonal typhoid, dengue, and urinary tract infections.
  • Cardiovascular & Hypertension Management: Longitudinal blood pressure tracking, echocardiography referrals, and kidney function monitoring.
  • Respiratory Ailments: Bronchitis, chronic cough, COPD stabilization, and post-viral pulmonary recovery.
  • Gastrointestinal & Liver Health: Peptic disease, acute gastroenteritis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and metabolic liver screening.

Consultation Timings & OPD Details

Outpatient consultations are available Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Walk-ins are accommodated promptly, and priority queues are maintained for elderly patients and emergency assessments.
